objective: Reduce new-dataset auto-draft latency without weakening ontology review or allowing destructive global-surface edits.

optimization.scope: reference_draft with auto_detect_visible=true and no human reference geometry
optimization.removed_call: a second VLM request for generic unreferenced description and SAM keywords
optimization.replacement: deterministic canonical prompts for the bounded known-label set returned by visible-label discovery
optimization.unknown_label_behavior: unchanged; unknown candidates and registry conflicts remain human-review-only
optimization.explicit_label_behavior: unchanged; manual explicit-label drafts retain the VLM unreferenced-description path

rejected_intermediate.observed_problem: Agent proposed an erase_region that removed 43.182 percent of the broad floor candidate
rejected_intermediate.decision: not accepted for deployment because visible floor geometry regressed

additional_safety_guard.policy: an automatic erase_region may remove at most 25 percent of an existing floor or slope candidate

observed_latency_comparison.warning: single same-image runs with stochastic models; not a latency distribution

regression.guard_cases: large erase rejected, bounded local erase allowed, large surface reclassification rejected, small reclassification allowed

limitations: The source image has no human pixel truth; semantic labels and visual preservation were checked, but cross-dataset IoU is not established.
No slope is visible in this sample, so slope quality has no new evidence.
A single image A/B cannot establish a stable latency distribution.
